;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Protestors storm the [[MONUSCO]] headquarters in [[Beni, Democratic Republic of the Congo|Beni]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], and set [[United Nations|UN]] vehicles on fire in anger at the [[United Nations peacekeeping|peacekeepers]]' failure to stop the [[Allied Democratic Forces]] [[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency|insurgency]]. Congolese security forces fire at the crowd to disperse them, killing at least two. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/killed-rebel-attack-dr-congo-city-beni-191125105346272.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Business and economy
*[[Transport for London]] announces it will not grant a new license to operate to [[Uber]], citing safety failures. The company will appeal. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-50544283 (BBC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Ménaka helicopter crash]]
**Thirteen [[French soldier]]s are killed in a helicopter crash during an operation against [[jihadists]] in [[Mali]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50557511?ns_linkname=news_central&ns_mchannel=social&ns_campaign=bbc_breaking&ns_source=twitter (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[2019 Samoa measles outbreak]]
**[[Fiji]]an Health Minister [[Ifereimi Waqainabete]] warns that [[law enforcement in Fiji|police]] will be deployed to areas under [[quarantine]] if people continue not to respect the order to stay at home if they have [[measles]], amid an ongoing outbreak of the illness in various [[Pacific island]] nations. [https://www.fijitimes.com/ministry-sounds-warning-as-measles-cases-rise/ (''Fiji Times'')] [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/404072/authorities-in-fiji-urge-public-to-respect-quarantine (RNZ)]

;International relations

**[[Hossein Salami]], commander-in-chief of the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] delivers a televised speech toward [[Israel]], [[Saudi Arabia]], the [[United States]] and those who are protesting against the government in which he says "We will destroy you" if they cross Iran's red line. ;Law and crime
*[[Essex lorry deaths]]
**The driver of the lorry in which 39 Vietnamese migrants were found dead in [[Grays, Essex|Grays]], [[Essex]], [[England]], pleads guilty to conspiring to assist [[unlawful immigration]]. [https://independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime/essex-lorry-deaths-maurice-robinson-mo-guilty-trafficking-immigration-latest-a9216561.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Catholic Church sexual abuse cases by country#Argentina|Catholic Church sexual abuse cases in Argentina]]
**Two [[Roman Catholic]] priests are sentenced to more than 40 years in prison for [[sexually assault]]ing deaf children at a church school in [[Mendoza Province]], Argentina; the school's gardener also receives an 18-year sentence. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-50549918 (BBC News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/25/roman-catholic-priests-argentina-sentenced-45-years-child-abuse-school-deaf (''The Guardian'')]
